lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review common plural noun forms in a practical setting.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Preparing fika or a small meeting room at work.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Counting and asking for everyday items.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik prepare for fika or a meeting and check whether they have enough cups, glasses, chairs, books, bags, or buns.

main_focus.name: common plural nouns
main_focus.description: Use practical plural forms with numbers and simple quantity words.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use common plural nouns naturally 5-7 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic adjective use only if natural

vocabulary_target.theme: plural items for fika or a meeting
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use plural forms for concrete objects that would appear around a break or meeting.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker notices they need items for fika or a meeting.
dialogue_shape.middle: They count or check several plural items and decide what is enough.
dialogue_shape.ending: They confirm the items are ready or decide to fetch one more thing.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat plural nouns with simple numbers and quantity words

focus: how many of one item there are
whether they have enough for fika or the meeting

sentence_focus: one sentence with a number and a plural noun
one sentence saying something is enough
